original.reason: The lower-bound implication is false: a blocking colouring need not meet every length-100 row/column interval, since coloured teeth in the adjacent line may block the corresponding comb. The 400-square congruence construction is a valid upper bound, but minimality is unproved.

judgment.reason: It correctly identifies the original lower-bound flaw, but its claimed 400-square column construction does not block vertical combs in consecutive column pairs avoiding columns 1 and 101.
The critique of the lower bound is correct, but colouring columns 1 and 101 does not block vertical combs whose two columns avoid both coloured columns.

It correctly rejects the lower-bound converse, but incorrectly restricts horizontal placements to the two boundary 100-column blocks and falsely asserts that all vertical combs have a coloured full side.
